title: Practice 1: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ви́дение** — vision, sight. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**сиде́ние** — sitting. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: There's a blanket in the back seat.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **чте́ние** — reading (the process of interpreting written language). Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**чтения** — чте́ние: reading (the process of interpreting written language); reading (legislature: one of several stages a bill passes through before becoming law). Wiktionary: читать + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **проше́ние** — petition, application (a verbal or written request). Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**прошение** — проше́ние: petition, application (a verbal or written request). Wiktionary: проси́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **положе́ние** — position, location. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: reading (the process of interpreting written language)
petition, application (a verbal or written request)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ви́дение — vision, sight; сиде́ние — sitting; чте́ние — reading (the process of interpreting written language); проше́ние — petition, application (a verbal or written request).
**положение** — положе́ние: position, location; situation; state, condition; standing. Wiktionary: положи́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **отноше́ние** — attitude. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**отношениях** — отноше́ние: attitude; treatment; relation, regard, respect, consideration; ratio. Wiktionary: относи́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
